bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Updates - New features enhance user experience and network performance testing capabilities.
AI-Powered Photo Organization - Microsoft Photos now features AI-driven auto-categorization for easier photo management.
Microsoft Marketplace Launch - A unified platform for cloud solutions and AI apps enhances customer access to innovations.
Windows ML Now Available - Developers can leverage local AI capabilities across Windows devices for enhanced performance.
Expanding AI Model Choices - Microsoft 365 Copilot now supports Anthropic models for enhanced flexibility in AI applications.
